title: communication brief
description: communication/brief.yaml: the paper's own sentences that every communication of it restates, each quoted verbatim from the manuscript or the analysis plan. `manuscript-guard communicate brief` writes it; the author marks which finding is primary.

findings.description: The findings, each with the results it binds and whether it is the paper's primary finding. The author marks it; nothing infers it.

keys.description: The values the finding binds, as `results.key` or `lit.key`.

primary.description: true for the paper's primary finding, as the author marks it.

text.description: The statement as a communication may restate it: its source sentence, or shorter. Held to its source as any communication is.

file.description: The manuscript file, or design/plan.md, relative to the project's root.

quote.description: The sentence as the file has it, word for word; runs of white space are one space.
